messages.author: 5fb43f04522057bf
messages.subject: Re: msvcr120.dll is missing after installing MRO 3.2.3
parts:
Hello. We are currently working on a resolution to this issue. In the interim, you should get the msvcr120.dll library by installing the Visual C++ Redistributable package which can be found here: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=40784

In addition, it is important to note that the solution that is depicted in the youtube link posted above is not safe. DLL download sites are notorious for injecting malware into the downloads that you get from them. The dll should only be obtained from Microsoft through the C++ redistributable that I posted above.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Nathan
